ui.browser.chrome.approvals.role: browser toolbar tooltip and accessible name
ui.browser.chrome.approvals.length: Keep concise for a small toolbar tooltip.
ui.browser.chrome.approvals.note: Names the shield control opening agent approval requests and site-access policy. Does not promise that clicking grants access. Browser page chrome, not application settings.

ui.browser.chrome.error_title.length: Aim for 28 characters for menu labels; feedback may wrap. Never truncate page-title placeholders.
ui.browser.chrome.error_title.note: Slice-b browser page tabs, NOT application-level project/chat tabs. English fallback only until audited translations exist.

placeholders.title: Untranslated page-title user data
placeholders.loading: yes/no token; failed tabs suppress loading
placeholders.owner: agent/shared/user token; shared means a user tab handed to an agent
placeholders.waiting: none, or the decimal queue REQUEST ORDINAL (not a request count)
placeholders.restored: yes/no token; restored from a prior browser run
